jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: Production AI and machine-learning systems for fraud detection, analyst workflows, and scalable model deployment.
achievements: Developed fraud-detection models using PyTorch, XGBoost, and engineered transaction features across large-scale financial datasets, improving detection accuracy while reducing unnecessary alerts.
Built distributed machine-learning pipelines with PySpark, Airflow, and AWS SageMaker to automate data preparation, feature generation, training, and model evaluation.
Created Retrieval-Augmented Generation applications using LangChain, embedding models, and FAISS to help analysts retrieve relevant information from enterprise documents.
Implemented LangGraph-based agent workflows with tool calling to automate portions of fraud-investigation and risk-analysis processes.
Established model evaluation and experiment tracking with MLflow, SHAP, and LLM evaluation frameworks to measure predictive performance, retrieval quality, and hallucination behavior.
Containerized and deployed AI services with FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, monitoring, and CI/CD workflows.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Enterprise machine-learning, NLP, semantic-search, and inference workflows for analytics and document intelligence.
achievements: Developed machine-learning and data-processing pipelines using Python, SQL, and PySpark for enterprise analytics and prediction workflows.
Built classification, regression, risk-analysis, and forecasting models using Scikit-learn, XGBoost, and LightGBM.
Implemented NLP workflows for document classification, named entity recognition, text extraction, and information retrieval.
Developed RAG and semantic-search prototypes using LangChain, embedding models, and FAISS for natural-language access to enterprise documents.
Deployed inference services using FastAPI, Docker, AWS, and automated CI/CD workflows.
Improved distributed ETL and feature-engineering workloads using Apache Spark and Databricks.
